test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A fruit seller buys 480 bananas for Rs. 1,200. Some of these bananas are rotten and hence, they are thrown away. He sells the remaining bananas at Rs. 3.5 each and makes a profit of Rs. 396. What is the percentage of bananas thrown away?
solution:
Given:

480 bananas for Rs. 1,200

The remaining bananas sold at Rs. 3.5 each

A profit of = Rs. 396

Concept:

Average = (Sum of total items)/(Total number of items)

Total expenditure = Price of per unit × Total number of unit

Calculation:

Profit = 1200 + 396 = 1596

Total bananas sold at Rs. 3.5 each to earn a profit of 396 = 1596/3.5

= 456

Bananas that are rotten = 480 - 456 = 24

= 24 / 480 × 100 = 5%

∴ The required result will be 5 %.
